notes.title: Minor Patch
notes.notes:
Fixed Winter Level Music Slider 
and Fixed level 4 so it is now possible!

notes.title: Winter Update Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, after lots of work I finally present Block Hoppers Winter Update to you!

This update includes new features I will let you discover in the levels and a few new achievements!

Added:
- Animations 
- Lots of new assets
- Some new graphic shading
- New obstacles 
and many more!


I want to thank everyone who has supported the game it has been an awesome year!

I wish you all a Merry Christmas, Happy Holidays, and a Happy New Year!

notes.title: Minor Bug Fix
notes.notes: Made it so levels will no longer crash after being selected.

notes.title: Fall Update
notes.notes:
Hello, 
To start, thank you for supporting the game. This update not only adds some new content to the experience and adds some variety to some of the levels but also addresses several issues that have been brought forward to me by you. 

Added:
- New bonus levels with a fall theme 
- New obstacles to experience. 
- More variants to endless mode
- Changed the look of some of the levels
- Added controller support except for the pause menu 

Fixed:
- It is now harder to fall off the level in the Ultra Level
- Fixed the reset boxes to properly reset your position when you fall off 
- Fixed several lighting issues.

notes.title: Fall Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I want to start by saying thank you for getting the game and supporting it. 

That being said Block Hopper will be getting a new update that will include multiple bug fixes and visual treats. Coming September first, 2024 the fall update will come out. I hope you will all enjoy the small new things I have added to the game and I hope that you look forward to the new levels as well. 

Thanks once again for supporting the game and myself!

notes.title: Endless Game Mode Update
notes.notes: After multiple attempts and different approaches to the leaderboard situation, I have found currently with a lack of funds I can not connect the endless mode to a steam leaderboard. I have tried some alternative routes and none have been fruitful so for now endless mode will come out with a functional score system. you can even post your scores in the block hopper discord when the game mode is released.

Made the pause menu text easier to read.

SFX Changes:

Added sound effects to moving platforms
Added sound effects to Surprise entity 

Changes overall:
Added surprise entity

notes.title: Quality of Life and Recommended Changes
notes.notes:
In this update, I present to you some minor changes but changes that I think will change the way you play the game or enjoy the game by a significant amount. 

List of changes:
- There no longer is eye adaptation/light adaptation. 
- There is a level selector for the casual game mode so you don't need to start again when you leave the game
- The camera has been zoomed out to give the ability to see more things and hopefully get a better understanding of the levels. 
- some of the levels have had minor adjustments in obstacles 
- Brightness has been increased slightly to make the darker levels easier but not increased so much that it will affect the lighter levels by much

I hope you all had a good easter weekend and I hope you enjoy this update in this fun but annoying game!

notes.title: Menu and Performance Patch
notes.notes:
Some reflections have been reduced drastically to improve performance. 

As well as the options menu has had a color pallet update in hopes of making it easier to read and interact with.
